remarks: Back on the market after receiving multiple offers, here is your second chance to make this beautifully remodeled In-Town Cape your own! Timeless charm meets exceptional craftsmanship in this turnkey 4 bedroom, 2 bath home with a thoughtfully designed open concept floor plan. The stunning designer kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring quartz countertops, a large center island, high end appliances, and abundant cabinetry, flowing effortlessly into the inviting living room with a striking fireplace finished in Tumble Natural Travertine Tuscany tile. Just off the kitchen, the spacious dining room features custom built-in cabinetry and a wine chiller, creating the perfect space for entertaining or everyday gatherings. A custom mudroom adds convenience, while two bedrooms and a beautifully renovated full bathroom complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious primary bedroom, an additional bedroom, and a second full bathroom, offering a flexible layout for family, guests, or a home office. Step outside to enjoy the new stone patio overlooking the level backyard, along with a one car garage and beautifully refreshed landscaping. Extensively renovated from top to bottom with quality finishes throughout, this exceptional home is just moments from shopping, restaurants, schools, parks, the train, and major commuting routes. Don't miss this unexpected second opportunity to make it yours!
